title: Jere Puttar Kun Dekh Na Rajda Han
body:
Jahray Putar Ko Dekh Na Rajda Ha Ondi Lash Te Aya Jhan Jhan Ke
<<DIVIDER>>
Maidan Ich Syed Gulainda Ha Apna Sarmaya Jhan Jahn Ke
<<DIVIDER>>
Maqtal Vich Nazar Na Anda Ha Akhyan Da Noor Musafar Ku
Ik Val Val A Sambhlaindi Haye Zakhmi Mastoor Musafar Ku
Shabeer Ku Sohnay Bachray Tain Zahra Pohnchaya Jhan Jhan Ke
<<DIVIDER>>
Ditha Ahnda Akbar Babay Ku Laga Uthan Batool De Laal Kitay
Agay Sokha Jhukda Ha Bachra Babay De Istaqbal Kitay
Aj Zakham Hay Gahra Seenay Te Hath Qadam Te Aya Jhan Jhan Ke
<<DIVIDER>>
Thiya Tukray Jigar Kaheen Jaa Te Ham Shakal Rasool Da Jhanda Ha
Mas Lahnday Lal Sambhal Othaan Ohwain Putar Batool Da Jhanda Ha
Shah Putar Di Pak Jawani Da Har Tukra Chaya Jhan Jhan Ke
<<DIVIDER>>
Sah Ghutday Vaindan Akbar De Mahsoos Hussain Ku Theenda Hay
Hiway Ay Dastoor Janazay Ku Aram De Nal Rakheenda Hay
A Pahla Mayat Jaikun Kand Ton Mazloom Lahaya Jhan Jhan Ke
<<DIVIDER>>
Shah Putar Jawan De Lashay Ko Cha Safar Karainda Thak Pondaye
Thori Door Konon Ey Baykus Kun Koi Jhirak Jo Dainda Thak Pondaye
Khaimay Ghin Wanjan Di Sik Jo Haye Shah Putar Ko Chaya Jhan Jhan Ke
<<DIVIDER>>
Aya Gohar Lasha Akbar Da Har Parda Dar Dita Pursa
Kita Pak Batool Di Dhyan Hin Haye Thi Ke Bajh Rida Pursa
Mazloom Bhira Ku Putar Kitay Bhaindi Parchaya Jhan Jhan Ke
<<DIVIDER>>
Maiku Kand Te Chaya Sajday Ich Aj Vich Karbal De A Nana
Taindi Pak Shabeeh Ko Cha Ke Main Paya Turda Kamar Niwa Nana
A Dekh Jo Dhalay Hoye Bakhat Ich Main Tenda Qaraz Chukaya Jhan Jhan Ke
